---
name: Prompt improvement
about: Suggest a change to an existing prompt or propose a new one
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Which prompt?**
Name the prompt file (e.g. `prd-to-rfcs-prompt.md`), or "new prompt" with a proposed name.

**What's the problem?**
What does the prompt currently do (or fail to do) that this change fixes? Concrete examples of bad output are the most useful evidence.

**Proposed change**
The wording or structure change you suggest. For new prompts, follow the structure in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Which tools/models did you test with?**
e.g. Claude Code + Sonnet, Cursor + GPT-5. Per CONTRIBUTING, prompt changes should be tested with at least 2 different LLMs.
